fusions.name: Hearthside Prick
fusions.desc: Flicks a stinger that deals 4 damage. 25% of the damage it deals comes back as healing over the following 5 seconds, rather than at once.

fusions.name: Herd Shove
fusions.desc: Looses a wide cone ahead of you, dealing 12 damage to everything caught in it and knocking it back 2.5 tiles. Its damage rises 8% for each ally nearby (max +32%).

fusions.name: Barn Warmth
fusions.desc: Restores 12 health to you and every ally within 4.5 tiles, and more the faster you cast. Using it increases your movement speed by 10% for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Slow Comfort
fusions.desc: When you gain health, you receive 30% more healing for 8 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
